steps.text: The game checks for AVX at launch and stops with "Death Stranding requires a CPU with AVX support" when Rosetta hides it (highball#107, M5). The recipe advertises AVX to the game. DirectX 12, so D3DMetal. Unverified until the reporter confirms.

knownIssues.symptom: "Death Stranding requires a CPU with AVX support" at launch (reported on an M5)
knownIssues.fix: the recipe advertises AVX to the game (ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1), or the Compatibility switch in Environment settings
